text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's hotels face big municipality tax increases of up to 433 percent.
- Bahrain has no reservation about draft minutes proposed by Gulf Arab reconciliation committee to end dispute with Qatar.
- Bahrain denies harbouring a Qatari wanted by Qatari authorities for a criminal offence.
- More than half a million people visited Bahrain in December says study.
- Bahrain spent $18.2 million on information in 1996 says report.
